language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hello, I am Tim.
Welcome to Easter Islands! My name is Atua. On days like this I enjoy walking around the island and observing how things work in the world.
There are many rocks over here. This morning, I cut my foot on a rock. My toe was bleeding. I’m okay now, it made me wonder how blood works in the body.
Let’s find out how the blood circulatory system works!

Help Atua determine which statement is true and which is false.
Thank you! Now I know much more about the circulatory system.
I already know a lot about the circulatory system, but I want to learn more! I asked my grandfather if he could explain me more. This is what he told me:

At first, the blood is out of oxygen and nutrients and it travels in the veins to the heart. From the heart, the blood travels to the lungs, where it is filled with oxygen. The blood then goes back to the heart, where it is sent out to the rest of the body in the arteries.
The arteries transport the blood to the capillaries, where the body uses the oxygen and nutrients it needs. Then it travels to the veins and back to the heart to repeat the system over again.
